items.headline: Samudera Indonesia raises Rp 1.75T from sukuk offering
points: PT Samudera Indonesia Tbk completes a sukuk offering, raising Rp 1.75T, Kontan reports.
The company targeted Rp 2T in the public sukuk issuance.

sources.title: Penawaran Sukuk Tuntas, SMDR Meraup Dana Segar Rp 1,75 Triliun

items.hl_id: Samudera Indonesia raup Rp 1.75T dari penerbitan sukuk
pts_id: PT Samudera Indonesia Tbk merampungkan penawaran sukuk dan menghimpun Rp 1.75T, lapor Kontan.
Perusahaan menargetkan Rp 2T dalam penerbitan sukuk publik tersebut.

items.headline: Purbaya names Budi Susanto as SMF president director
points: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa appointed Budi Susanto as SMF president director effective Sept. 10.
Budi Susanto replaced Ananta Wiyogo, who had served as acting president director.

sources.title: Pengurus SMF Dirombak, Purbaya Angkat Budi Susanto Jadi Dirut

items.hl_id: Purbaya tunjuk Budi Susanto jadi dirut SMF
pts_id: Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa menunjuk Budi Susanto sebagai direktur utama SMF efektif Sept. 10.
Budi Susanto menggantikan Ananta Wiyogo, yang sebelumnya menjabat pelaksana tugas direktur utama.

items.headline: Lippo Cikarang names Ketut Budi Wijaya commissioner
points: Lippo Cikarang shareholders appoint Ketut Budi Wijaya commissioner, replacing Charles Rigoux.
The board term runs until the close of the 2029 annual shareholders meeting.
LPCK received Rigoux’s resignation letter on July 17, 2026.

sources.title: RUPSLB Lippo Cikarang Angkat Ketut Budi Wijaya Jadi Komisaris

items.hl_id: Lippo Cikarang angkat Ketut Budi Wijaya jadi komisaris
pts_id: Pemegang saham Lippo Cikarang mengangkat Ketut Budi Wijaya sebagai komisaris, menggantikan Charles Rigoux.
Masa jabatan dewan berlaku hingga penutupan RUPST 2029.
LPCK menerima surat pengunduran diri Rigoux pada July 17, 2026.

items.headline: Telkom estimates Rp17T impact from unit streamlining
points: Telkom estimates Rp17T in cut losses and other impacts from streamlining subsidiaries.
Danantara COO Dony Oskaria projects Telkom profit may rise 30% after completion.
Affected units include PINS Indonesia, Telkomsigma and Infomedia Nusantara.

sources.title: Telkom (TLKM) Hitung Cut Loss Rp 17 T Imbas Perampingan, Incar Laba Naik 30%? - Bursa Katadata.co.id

items.hl_id: Telkom taksir dampak Rp17T dari perampingan anak usaha
pts_id: Telkom menaksir Rp17T dari pemangkasan kerugian dan dampak lain lewat perampingan anak usaha.
COO Danantara Dony Oskaria memproyeksikan laba Telkom bisa naik 30% setelah perampingan rampung.
Unit terdampak mencakup PINS Indonesia, Telkomsigma, dan Infomedia Nusantara.

items.headline: PGN caps cheap gas supply at 80% for west Java industrial users
points: PGN told west Java customers it would limit HGBT gas supply to 80% of minimum contracted volume.
FIPGB said the cap could reduce factory utilization because some manufacturers rely on gas as primary energy.
West Java HGBT supply has reached about 88%-90% of the allocation under ESDM Ministerial Decree 281.K/2026.

sources.title: Industri Keluhkan Pasokan Gas Murah Dibatasi, Pabrik Keramik Kurangi Produksi

items.hl_id: PGN batasi pasokan gas murah 80% untuk industri Jawa Barat
pts_id: PGN memberi tahu pelanggan Jawa Barat akan membatasi pasokan gas HGBT menjadi 80% dari volume kontrak minimum.
FIPGB mengatakan batas itu bisa menurunkan utilisasi pabrik karena sebagian produsen memakai gas sebagai energi utama.
Pasokan HGBT Jawa Barat telah mencapai sekitar 88%-90% dari alokasi dalam Kepmen ESDM 281.K/2026.

items.headline: BPI Danantara targets Adhi Karya-PP merger by end-2026
points: BPI Danantara targets a merger of Adhi Karya and PP by end-2026.
The deal is part of a government plan to streamline seven state-owned construction firms.
Other firms in the plan include Waskita Karya, Wijaya Karya, Hutama Karya, Brantas Abipraya and Nindya Karya.

sources.title: Merger BUMN Karya Jadi Jalan Terakhir Meski tak Berarti Urusan Utang Langsung Tuntas

items.hl_id: BPI Danantara targetkan merger Adhi Karya-PP pada akhir 2026
pts_id: BPI Danantara menargetkan merger Adhi Karya dan PP pada akhir 2026.
Transaksi ini bagian dari rencana pemerintah merampingkan tujuh BUMN konstruksi.
Perusahaan lain dalam rencana ini mencakup Waskita Karya, Wijaya Karya, Hutama Karya, Brantas Abipraya, dan Nindya Karya.

items.headline: Satu Visi Putra plans 72.91% Hasna Medika acquisition
points: PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk plans to acquire 72.91% of PT Hasna Medika Bakti Cirebon.
The advertising and printing issuer will fund the healthcare expansion through a private placement.

sources.title: Memburu Untung dari Bisnis Baru

items.hl_id: Satu Visi Putra berencana akuisisi 72.91% Hasna Medika
pts_id: PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk berencana mengakuisisi 72.91% saham PT Hasna Medika Bakti Cirebon.
Emiten periklanan dan percetakan itu akan membiayai ekspansi ke layanan kesehatan melalui private placement.

items.headline: Foreign inflows resume as IHSG eyes 7,400 by late 2026
points: Kontan reports IHSG may reach 7,400 by late 2026 as foreign capital returns.
The index closed the latest week down 1.43% at 6,541.
Analysts linked volatility to the Federal Reserve’s September 15-16 FOMC meeting.

sources.title: Indonesia’s IHSG Eyes 7,400 Level as Foreign Capital Inflow Resumes

items.hl_id: Dana asing kembali masuk, IHSG incar 7,400 akhir 2026
pts_id: Kontan melaporkan IHSG bisa mencapai 7,400 pada akhir 2026 seiring kembalinya modal asing.
Indeks menutup pekan terbaru turun 1.43% di level 6,541.
Analis mengaitkan volatilitas dengan rapat FOMC Federal Reserve pada September 15-16.

items.headline: OJK revokes 13 bank licenses in 2026
points: OJK revoked 13 bank licenses in 2026, mostly BPR and BPRS lenders.
LPS covers eligible deposits up to Rp2 billion per customer per bank within five days.
Deposits above Rp2 billion depend on liquidation proceeds and asset recovery.

sources.title: 13 Bank Bangkrut, Bagaimana Nasib Uang Nasabah?

items.hl_id: OJK cabut 13 izin bank pada 2026
pts_id: OJK mencabut 13 izin bank pada 2026, mayoritas BPR dan BPRS.
LPS menjamin simpanan layak bayar hingga Rp2 miliar per nasabah per bank dalam lima hari.
Simpanan di atas Rp2 miliar bergantung pada hasil likuidasi dan pemulihan aset.

items.headline: Indonet bundles dedicated internet with AI for corporate clients
points: Indonet combined its dedicated internet service with AI access for business customers.
The package targets companies needing high-capacity data traffic and reliable networks.

sources.title: Indonet Integrasikan Layanan Internet Dedicated dengan AI, Bidik Segmen Bisnis

items.hl_id: Indonet gabungkan internet dedicated dan AI untuk klien korporat
pts_id: Indonet menggabungkan layanan internet dedicated dengan akses AI untuk pelanggan bisnis.
Paket ini menyasar perusahaan yang membutuhkan trafik data berkapasitas besar dan jaringan andal.

items.headline: Lintasarta adds Starlink to managed IT services for 2027
points: Lintasarta plans to bundle Starlink LEO connectivity with managed IT and cybersecurity services in 2027.
The Indosat unit will place Starlink within hybrid connectivity across satellite, fiber, cloud and cybersecurity.
Zulfi Hadi said growth will also come from higher bandwidth, not only terminal additions.

sources.title: Anak Usaha Indosat (Lintasarta) Racik Starlink jadi Solusi IT Terpadu 2027

items.hl_id: Lintasarta tambah Starlink ke layanan TI terkelola pada 2027
pts_id: Lintasarta berencana membundel konektivitas LEO Starlink dengan layanan TI terkelola dan keamanan siber pada 2027.
Unit Indosat ini akan menempatkan Starlink dalam konektivitas hybrid yang mencakup satelit, fiber, cloud, dan keamanan siber.
Zulfi Hadi mengatakan pertumbuhan juga akan datang dari kenaikan bandwidth, bukan hanya penambahan terminal.

items.headline: Bitcoin Suisse plans to cut up to 60 Swiss jobs
points: Bitcoin Suisse plans to cut up to 60 of 120 Swiss-based employees.
Consultation runs until Sept. 20, 2026, before final cuts are set.
The company will consolidate software development and back-office functions in international hubs.

sources.title: Bitcoin Suisse Berencana Pangkas 50% Karyawan

items.hl_id: Bitcoin Suisse berencana pangkas hingga 60 pekerja di Swiss
pts_id: Bitcoin Suisse berencana memangkas hingga 60 dari 120 pekerja berbasis di Swiss.
Konsultasi berjalan hingga Sept. 20, 2026, sebelum keputusan PHK final ditetapkan.
Perusahaan akan mengonsolidasikan pengembangan software dan fungsi back-office di hub internasional.

items.headline: Oracle adds US$700M to 2026 restructuring plan
points: Oracle added US$700M in expected costs to its 2026 restructuring plan, bringing the total to US$2.8B.
Most of the costs relate to severance for employees affected by job cuts.
Oracle had already recorded about US$2.1B in charges tied to the plan.

sources.title: Oracle Bakal Gelontorkan Tambahan Rp 12,32 Triliun Buat Pangkas Karyawan

items.hl_id: Oracle tambah US$700M ke rencana restrukturisasi 2026
pts_id: Oracle menambah estimasi biaya US$700M ke rencana restrukturisasi 2026, sehingga totalnya menjadi US$2.8B.
Sebagian besar biaya terkait pesangon bagi karyawan yang terdampak pemutusan kerja.
Oracle sudah mencatat biaya sekitar US$2.1B terkait rencana tersebut.

items.headline: OJK tells digital banks to diversify beyond online services
points: OJK told digital banks to develop services beyond moving existing banking products online.
Dian Ediana Rae said new products should target customer segments still underserved by banks.

sources.title: OJK Dorong Diversifikasi Bisnis Bank Digital, Wanti-Wanti Tidak Sekadar Gimik

items.hl_id: OJK minta bank digital diversifikasi di luar layanan online
pts_id: OJK meminta bank digital mengembangkan layanan di luar pemindahan produk perbankan lama ke kanal online.
Dian Ediana Rae mengatakan produk baru perlu menyasar segmen nasabah yang belum banyak terlayani bank.

items.headline: OJK records venture financing at Rp16.32T in July, down 0.46%
points: OJK data puts venture capital financing at Rp16.32 trillion in July 2026, down 0.46% year on year.
Amvesindo says the decline reflects more selective investment strategies, not limited liquidity.
OJK's March data showed Rp11.21 trillion went to productive business financing.

sources.title: Investor Semakin Selektif dalam Menyalurkan Pembiayaan Modal Ventura

items.hl_id: OJK catat pembiayaan ventura Rp16.32T pada Juli, turun 0.46%
pts_id: Data OJK mencatat pembiayaan modal ventura Rp16.32 triliun pada Juli 2026, turun 0.46% secara tahunan.
Amvesindo menyebut penurunan ini mencerminkan strategi investasi yang lebih selektif, bukan keterbatasan likuiditas.
Data OJK pada Maret menunjukkan Rp11.21 triliun mengalir ke pembiayaan usaha produktif.

items.headline: Pefindo keeps AAA rating on Pollux Hotels' Rp500B bonds
points: Pefindo maintained an idAAA(cg) rating on Pollux Hotels Group's Rp500 billion 2025 sustainability-linked bonds.
The rating covers the monitoring period from July 7, 2026, to July 1, 2027.
Series A carries Rp55 billion at 5.85%; Series B carries Rp445 billion at 6.25%.

sources.title: Obligasi Rp 500 Miliar POLI Kantongi Rating AAA dari Pefindo

items.hl_id: Pefindo pertahankan peringkat AAA obligasi Rp500B Pollux Hotels
pts_id: Pefindo mempertahankan peringkat idAAA(cg) atas obligasi terkait keberlanjutan 2025 Pollux Hotels Group senilai Rp500 miliar.
Peringkat berlaku untuk periode pemantauan July 7, 2026, hingga July 1, 2027.
Series A bernilai Rp55 miliar dengan kupon 5.85%; Series B bernilai Rp445 miliar dengan kupon 6.25%.

items.headline: Midea reaches 3M units in Indonesia, opens expanded AC plant
points: Midea logged 3M cumulative units in Indonesia and inaugurated expanded Cikarang air-conditioner production facilities.
The Cikarang site covers 51,405 square meters, with operational space planned to rise to 43,000 square meters.
Kontan reported 66% of output is exported to North America and ASEAN.

sources.title: China’s Midea Hits 3 Million Units in Indonesia, Boosts Global Export Hub

items.hl_id: Midea capai 3M unit di Indonesia, perluas pabrik AC
pts_id: Midea mencatat 3M unit kumulatif di Indonesia dan meresmikan perluasan fasilitas produksi AC di Cikarang.
Lahan Cikarang mencakup 51,405 meter persegi, dengan ruang operasional direncanakan naik menjadi 43,000 meter persegi.
Kontan melaporkan 66% produksi diekspor ke Amerika Utara dan ASEAN.

items.headline: Summit Oto Finance absorbs Oto Multiartha in merger plan
points: Summit Oto Finance and Oto Multiartha approved a merger plan, with Summit as the surviving entity.
OJK and shareholders of both companies approved the plan at Sept. 1 extraordinary meetings.

sources.title: Ini Respons APPI Terkait Aksi Merger Oto Multiartha dan Summit Oto Finance

items.hl_id: Summit Oto Finance serap Oto Multiartha lewat merger
pts_id: Summit Oto Finance dan Oto Multiartha menyetujui rencana merger, dengan Summit menjadi entitas penerus.
OJK dan pemegang saham kedua perusahaan menyetujui rencana itu dalam rapat luar biasa Sept. 1.

items.headline: Astra Financial, OJK train 1,000 financial literacy envoys
points: Astra Financial and OJK trained 1,000 Penggerak Duta Literasi Keuangan participants in Yogyakarta.
Participants were named Duta OJK Peduli to promote financial literacy among communities.
Kontan cites SNLIK 2026 literacy at 69.57% and inclusion at 93.61%; Antara reports inclusion at 93%.

sources.title: OJK Soroti Gap Literasi dan Inklusi Keuangan yang Tembus 20% Lebih
Astra Financial-OJK latih Penggerak Duta Literasi Keuangan - ANTARA News Yogyakarta - Berita Terkini Yogyakarta

items.hl_id: Astra Financial dan OJK latih 1,000 duta literasi keuangan
pts_id: Astra Financial dan OJK melatih 1,000 peserta Penggerak Duta Literasi Keuangan di Yogyakarta.
Peserta ditetapkan sebagai Duta OJK Peduli untuk mendorong literasi keuangan di masyarakat.
Kontan mengutip literasi SNLIK 2026 69.57% dan inklusi 93.61%; Antara melaporkan inklusi 93%.

items.headline: Amartha uses AI, diversification to manage MSME loan risk
points: Amartha is mitigating MSME financing risk through sector diversification and technology, Kontan reported.
The company uses digital tools and AI for credit scoring, service quality and operations.
Amartha serves more than 4 million women ultra-micro entrepreneurs across five Indonesian regions.
items.context: Amartha is a Jakarta Selatan fintech ranked 63, with US$46M recorded funding and about 10,000 employees.

sources.title: Amartha Terapkan Sejumlah Upaya Ini untuk Memitigasi Risiko Pembiayaan ke UMKM

items.hl_id: Amartha pakai AI, diversifikasi untuk kelola risiko pinjaman UMKM
pts_id: Amartha memitigasi risiko pembiayaan UMKM lewat diversifikasi sektor dan teknologi, lapor Kontan.
Perusahaan memakai alat digital dan AI untuk credit scoring, kualitas layanan, dan operasional.
Amartha melayani lebih dari 4 juta perempuan pengusaha ultra-mikro di lima wilayah Indonesia.
items.cx_id: Amartha adalah fintech Jakarta Selatan peringkat 63, dengan pendanaan tercatat US$46M dan jumlah pekerja sekitar 10,000 orang.

items.headline: Samir keeps TWP90 at 0% with stricter borrower checks
points: Samir recorded a 0% TWP90 ratio on Aug. 12, 2026, according to its website.
CEO Handy Juniandri says bank lenders require stricter risk controls before disbursement.
Indonesia's fintech lending industry TWP90 averaged 4.32% in July 2026.

sources.title: Ini Strategi Fintech Samir untuk Jaga TWP90 Tetap Terkendali

items.hl_id: Samir jaga TWP90 0% lewat seleksi peminjam lebih ketat
pts_id: Samir mencatat rasio TWP90 0% pada 12 Agustus 2026, menurut situs webnya.
CEO Handy Juniandri mengatakan pemberi pinjaman bank mensyaratkan kontrol risiko lebih ketat sebelum pencairan.
Rata-rata TWP90 industri fintech lending Indonesia mencapai 4.32% pada Juli 2026.

items.headline: Victoria Care secures Rp270.65B credit facilities from BNI
points: Victoria Care Indonesia secures Rp270.65B in credit facilities from BNI.
The package includes Rp200B revolving working-capital credit for its cosmetics business.
The 9 Sept. agreement equals 24.78% of 2025 audited equity.

sources.title: Victoria Care Indonesia (VICI) Terima Fasilitas Kredit dari BNI Rp 270,65 Miliar

items.hl_id: Victoria Care raih fasilitas kredit Rp270.65B dari BNI
pts_id: Victoria Care Indonesia memperoleh fasilitas kredit Rp270.65B dari BNI.
Paket ini mencakup kredit modal kerja revolving Rp200B untuk bisnis kosmetik.
Perjanjian 9 Sept. setara 24.78% dari ekuitas teraudit 2025.

items.headline: Asuransi Astra launches 3 insurance services
points: Asuransi Astra launched myGarda, gardaoto.com and Garda Siaga in Jakarta on Sept. 11.
President Director Maximiliaan Agatisianus said the products are integrated to simplify insurance use.
Asuransi Astra introduced Otocare in 2015 and Medcare a year later.

sources.title: Asuransi Astra Luncurkan 3 Inovasi Layanan, Ada myGarda hingga Garda Siaga

items.hl_id: Asuransi Astra meluncurkan 3 layanan asuransi
pts_id: Asuransi Astra meluncurkan myGarda, gardaoto.com, dan Garda Siaga di Jakarta pada Sept. 11.
President Director Maximiliaan Agatisianus mengatakan produk itu terintegrasi untuk mempermudah penggunaan asuransi.
Asuransi Astra memperkenalkan Otocare pada 2015 dan Medcare setahun kemudian.

items.headline: BCA, Batavia launch USD sharia fund with US$10,000 minimum
points: BCA and Batavia launched Batavia Gold Sharia Equity USD, a US dollar-denominated sharia mutual fund.
The fund targets aggressive-risk customers seeking sharia portfolio diversification and long-term investment growth.
Initial purchases start at US$10,000; subsequent purchases start at US$100.

sources.title: BCA dan Batavia Luncurkan Reksadana Batavia Gold Sharia Equity USD

items.hl_id: BCA, Batavia luncurkan reksa dana syariah USD minimum US$10,000
pts_id: BCA dan Batavia meluncurkan Batavia Gold Sharia Equity USD, reksa dana syariah berdenominasi dolar AS.
Produk ini menyasar nasabah berprofil risiko agresif yang mencari diversifikasi portofolio syariah dan pertumbuhan investasi jangka panjang.
Pembelian awal mulai US$10,000; pembelian berikutnya mulai US$100.

items.headline: Hypernet launches TokenKu.ai gateway for 120 AI models
points: Hypernet Technologies launched TokenKu.ai, a managed AI marketplace with access to more than 120 models.
The platform centralizes AI access, governance and rupiah invoicing with tax invoices.
Users can set virtual API keys and monthly spending caps by employee or division.

sources.title: Hypernet Technologies Rilis TokenKu.ai, Gateway Terpusat untuk 120 Model AI

items.hl_id: Hypernet meluncurkan gateway TokenKu.ai untuk 120 model AI
pts_id: Hypernet Technologies meluncurkan TokenKu.ai, marketplace AI terkelola dengan akses ke lebih dari 120 model.
Platform ini memusatkan akses AI, tata kelola, dan penagihan rupiah dengan faktur pajak.
Pengguna dapat mengatur API key virtual dan batas belanja bulanan per karyawan atau divisi.

items.headline: Chandra Asri targets 2 projects for 2027
points: Chandra Asri targets 2027 completion for a CA-EDC plant and Cycle & Carriage acquisition.
The CA-EDC project is intended to raise basic chemical production capacity.
Chandra Asri's website projects 3,000 construction jobs and 250 permanent roles.

sources.title: Chandra Asri (TPIA) Fokus Tuntaskan Dua Agenda Strategis

items.hl_id: Chandra Asri targetkan 2 proyek rampung pada 2027
pts_id: Chandra Asri menargetkan pabrik CA-EDC dan akuisisi Cycle & Carriage rampung pada 2027.
Proyek CA-EDC bertujuan meningkatkan kapasitas produksi bahan kimia dasar.
Situs Chandra Asri memproyeksikan 3,000 pekerjaan konstruksi dan 250 posisi tetap.

items.headline: Lintasarta manages 2,000 Starlink terminals in Indonesia
points: Lintasarta manages more than 2,000 active Starlink terminals as of August 2026.
The company acts as Starlink’s authorized reseller and managed connectivity provider for enterprise customers.
Lintasarta and Telkomsat have partnered with Starlink since 2024.

sources.title: Saingi Telkomsat, Lintasarta Kelola 2.000 Unit Terminal Starlink Agustus 2026

items.hl_id: Lintasarta kelola 2,000 terminal Starlink di Indonesia
pts_id: Lintasarta mengelola lebih dari 2,000 terminal aktif Starlink per Agustus 2026.
Perusahaan menjadi reseller resmi Starlink dan penyedia konektivitas terkelola untuk pelanggan enterprise.
Lintasarta dan Telkomsat bermitra dengan Starlink sejak 2024.

items.headline: BCA, Blibli Tiket launch card after 360,000 co-brand users
points: BCA and Blibli Tiket launched the BCA Blibli Tiket Mastercard credit card with Mastercard.
The card combines BCA's Blibli and tiket.com co-branded cards for rewards across the Blibli Tiket ecosystem.
Previous Blibli and tiket.com cards had nearly 360,000 users and almost Rp3 trillion in transactions.
items.context: Blibli ranks No. 5 in Commerce; tiket.com ranks No. 12 in Travel & Mobility and was fully acquired by Blibli in 2017.

sources.title: BCA Optimistis Nasabah Bertambah Lewat Integrasi Kartu Kredit Blibli & Tiket.com
BCA dan Ekosistem Blibli Tiket Hadirkan Kartu Kredit BCA Blibli Tiket Mastercard

BCA-Blibli Tiket luncurkan kartu kredit  "One Card More Rewards" - ANTARA News Banten

items.hl_id: BCA, Blibli Tiket luncurkan kartu usai 360,000 pengguna co-brand
pts_id: BCA dan Blibli Tiket meluncurkan kartu kredit BCA Blibli Tiket Mastercard bersama Mastercard.
Kartu ini menggabungkan kartu co-brand BCA untuk Blibli dan tiket.com dengan reward di ekosistem Blibli Tiket.
Kartu Blibli dan tiket.com sebelumnya memiliki hampir 360,000 pengguna dan transaksi hampir Rp3 triliun.
items.cx_id: Blibli menempati peringkat 5 di Commerce; tiket.com peringkat 12 di Travel & Mobility dan diakuisisi penuh oleh Blibli pada 2017.

items.headline: Vidio says it streams Pegadaian Championship 2026/27 exclusively
points: Vidio says Pegadaian Championship 2026/27 started on Sept. 11-13 and streams exclusively on its OTT service.
Vidio says Persis Solo, Semen Padang and PSBS Biak joined after relegation from Super League.
Vidio says RANS Nusantara, Dejan FC and PSGC Ciamis entered after promotion from Liga Nusantara.
items.context: Vidio is ranked 11 in the census, with US$150M funding and Media & Gaming as its sector.

points: PT Adi Sarana Armada gets Rp 600B in credit from Bank OCBC NISP.

items.headline: Indonesia records 1,198 labor disputes through July 2026
points: Indonesia’s Manpower Ministry recorded 1,198 industrial relations disputes in January-July 2026.

items.headline: KSPN plans 10,000-worker DPR rally on Sept. 28 for labor bill
points: KSPN says 10,000 members will rally at Indonesia's parliament on Sept. 28 over a labor protection bill.

Ketua KSPN Ristadi menyampaikan rencana itu setelah bertemu Menteri Ketenagakerjaan Yassierli di Jakarta pada Sept. 9.

items.headline: Indonesia EV investment reaches Rp30.4T, ministry says
points: Indonesia’s battery-electric vehicle industry has drawn Rp30.4T in investment, the Industry Ministry said.

points: BYD Indonesia opens its electric-vehicle factory in Subang, West Java.
The 126-hectare facility employs more than 5,000 local workers.

points: Chery Sales Indonesia is discussing a possible acquisition of Handal Indonesia Motor’s factory.

points: Indonesia's government aims to make the country a global content producer, Creative Economy Minister Teuku Riefky Harsya said.
Nusantara Rising is expected to support co-production and co-investment financing for creative economy businesses.
Harsya cited film, animation, games and music as target subsectors.

Harsya menyebut film, animasi, gim, dan musik sebagai subsektor sasaran.

items.headline: Lalamove, Green SM push into Indonesian ride-hailing
points: Lalamove is expanding Lalamove Ride into motorcycle and car passenger transport in Indonesia.
Green SM is developing an electric-vehicle transport service in Indonesia.

items.context: Gojek ranks No. 1 in Travel & Mobility, with US$5.3B funding and an IDX IPO in 2022.

items.headline: Tuntun Sekuritas launches desktop app for investors
points: PT Tuntun Sekuritas Indonesia launched a desktop version of its Tuntun app.
The app lets customers monitor portfolios, watchlists, market information and insights.
Tuntun had 250,000 users as of September 2026, Kontan reported.

items.headline: Indonesia targets US$618.1B downstream investment pipeline
points: Indonesia outlined three strategies to attract downstream investment, covering planning, execution and incentives.

Pemerintah merevisi aturan perizinan dan mengintegrasikan layanan melalui sistem OSS.

points: KAI will launch Nusantara Explorer as a charter and open-trip tourism train.
The train will combine onboard lodging, meals and stops at tourist destinations.

pts_id: KAI akan meluncurkan Nusantara Explorer sebagai kereta wisata charter dan open trip.

items.headline: XLSmart plans Rp20T capex to extend 5G to 101 cities
points: XLSmart plans Rp20 trillion in 2026 capex to expand 5G coverage to 101 cities and regencies.

XLSmart gained 80 MHz of spectrum from July auctions for 700 MHz and 2.6 GHz bands.

items.headline: BI raises liquidity incentive to 6% as banks get Rp446.5T
points: Bank Indonesia raises the KLM liquidity incentive to 6% from 5.5% starting September 2026.
Banks received Rp446.5T in incentives by early August 2026, equal to 5.02% of deposits.
BI says unused approved loans show credit demand remains a constraint.

sources.title: BI Guyur Insentif Likuiditas Rp446,5 T, Kredit Harus Mengalir ke UMKM

items.hl_id: BI naikkan insentif likuiditas ke 6%, bank terima Rp446.5T
pts_id: Bank Indonesia menaikkan insentif likuiditas KLM menjadi 6% dari 5.5% mulai September 2026.
Bank menerima insentif Rp446.5T hingga awal Agustus 2026, setara 5.02% dari dana pihak ketiga.
BI menyebut kredit disetujui yang belum ditarik menunjukkan permintaan kredit masih menjadi kendala.

items.headline: Jakarta court upholds Nicko Widjaja's 3-year venture case sentence
points: Jakarta High Court upheld Nicko Widjaja's three-year prison sentence and Rp350 million fine.
The case concerns alleged corruption and money laundering tied to BRI Ventures and MDI Ventures' Tanihub investment.
Nicko cited OJK Regulation No. 35/2015 on venture capital investments in startups and distressed companies.

sources.title: Nicko Kecewa dengan Putusan Banding: Ada Aturan Khusus Buat Bisnis Modal Ventura - Nasional Katadata.co.id

pts_id: Pengadilan Tinggi Jakarta menguatkan vonis penjara tiga tahun dan denda Rp350 juta terhadap Nicko Widjaja.
Kasus ini terkait dugaan korupsi dan pencucian uang dalam investasi Tanihub oleh BRI Ventures dan MDI Ventures.
Nicko mengutip POJK No. 35/2015 tentang investasi modal ventura di startup dan perusahaan bermasalah.

items.headline: CBRE seeks Rp1.27T as 10 IDX issuers plan rights issues
points: CBRE plans a Rp1.27T rights issue by selling 11.80B new shares to existing shareholders.
Ten IDX-listed companies disclosed rights-issue plans for August-September, according to CNBC Indonesia.
CBRE set the exercise price at Rp108 per share in a Sept. 1 prospectus summary.

CBRE menetapkan harga pelaksanaan Rp108 per saham dalam ringkasan prospektus 1 September.

points: Cakra Buana Resources Energi plans to sell up to 11.8 billion shares at Rp108 each.
Four buyers will take Rp858.6 billion through receivables conversion.
Trading and exercise of the rights are scheduled for Nov. 6-12.

points: MORA adds up to Rp 4T in investment credit from BCA.
The facility funds homepass capex, CPE and supporting operations, excluding FWA homepass capex.
The amended loan, signed Aug. 31, runs up to seven years, including a one-year grace period.

Perubahan pinjaman yang diteken Aug. 31 ini bertenor hingga tujuh tahun, termasuk masa tenggang satu tahun.

items.headline: OJK plans BEI demutualization rule in September 2026
points: OJK says BEI demutualization rules are in finalization and targeted for September 2026 issuance.
OJK has approved the draft internally and is awaiting harmonization with the Law Ministry.
OJK plans a final drafting discussion on Sept. 4, 2026.

pts_id: OJK mengatakan aturan demutualisasi BEI dalam tahap finalisasi dan ditargetkan terbit pada September 2026.
OJK telah menyetujui draf secara internal dan menunggu harmonisasi dengan Kementerian Hukum.
OJK menjadwalkan pembahasan penyusunan akhir pada Sept. 4, 2026.

items.headline: OJK drafts Rp1T capital rule for unit-linked insurers
points: OJK is drafting a POJK requiring unit-linked insurers to hold Rp500B core capital by Dec. 31, 2028.
The draft raises the threshold to Rp1T after Dec. 31, 2028.
Sharia insurers would need Rp200B core capital by 2028 and Rp500B afterward.

Draf itu menaikkan ambang modal inti menjadi Rp1T setelah Dec. 31, 2028.
Asuransi syariah wajib memiliki modal inti Rp200B pada 2028 dan Rp500B setelahnya.

points: LNSW opened SINSW API access for export-import businesses on Sept. 1, 2026.

pts_id: LNSW membuka akses API SINSW bagi pelaku ekspor-impor pada 1 September 2026.

items.headline: JP Morgan lowers 2026 IHSG target to 7,000
points: JP Morgan revised its end-2026 IHSG projection to 7,000.

Penerbitan saham itu memenuhi batas kepemilikan asing 85% di Indonesia menurut POJK 47/2020.

items.headline: Destry Damayanti takes BI helm, puts stability first
points: Destry Damayanti took office as Bank Indonesia governor after a Sept. 2 Supreme Court swearing-in.
She said policy will prioritize macroeconomic stability while calibrating instruments for growth.
Aida S. Budiman and Solikin M. Juhro also began five-year deputy governor terms.

Dia mengatakan kebijakan akan memprioritaskan stabilitas makroekonomi sambil mengalibrasi instrumen untuk pertumbuhan.
Aida S. Budiman dan Solikin M. Juhro juga memulai masa jabatan deputi gubernur lima tahun.

The resignation takes effect after an extraordinary shareholders meeting approves it, while the company said operations, legal status, finances and business continuity are unaffected.

items.headline: Expert backs OJK oral rate order in 97-platform pinjol appeal
points: Administrative law expert Adrian Rompis told a Jakarta Commercial Court appeal that OJK’s oral order on online-lending rate limits can be legally valid.
KPPU had found 97 online lenders at fault over rate-setting, while platforms challenged the ruling.

items.headline: Bank Indonesia names 7 banks, opens KKI issuer role to PJPs
points: Bank Indonesia said all licensed payment service providers can become issuers of its retail Kartu Kredit Indonesia, after naming seven banks and BSI for the initial rollout.
The card, launched Aug. 17, adds deferred-payment services and works across EDC terminals that accept credit cards and QRIS.

items.headline: Prominence launches Pemuda.ai for AI token marketplace
points: PT Kencana Satu Nuswapada, or Prominence, introduced Pemuda.ai as an AI token marketplace and Token-as-a-Service platform in Indonesia.
The service targets developers, businesses and government users for token quota management, cost controls and token transactions.

items.headline: Pintu launches Futures Lite with up to 25x leverage
points: Pintu launched Pintu Futures Lite, a crypto derivatives trading feature with leverage of up to 25x.
The feature lets users open long or short positions, set margin and leverage, and add take-profit and stop-loss orders in one flow.
items.context: Pintu is rank 32 in Fintech with US$156M funding and an estimated 964 employees.

items.headline: LinkAja says first-half EBITDA rises more than 200%
points: LinkAja said first-half 2026 EBITDA rose more than 200% year on year, net profit more than 100% and MAUs 5%.
The company said it is shifting from digital payments to a financial service enabler across B2C, B2B and B2B2C services.
items.context: Census ranks LinkAja No. 41 in Fintech, with US$100M funding and 472 estimated employees as of Aug. 29, 2026.

items.headline: Tokocrypto says OJK rules lift trust in crypto assets
points: Tokocrypto said OJK rules are increasing trust in Indonesia’s crypto-asset market.
The company said the framework gives the industry certainty and user protection as this year’s crypto market slows.
items.context: Tokocrypto ranks 237 in the census, with about 100 employees in Jakarta Selatan and a 2022 Binance acquisition as its last round.

points: PT Kencana Satu Nuswapada, or Prominence, introduced AI platform Pemuda.ai and signed an MoU with Onno Center.

items.headline: Traveloka releases Q2 2026 SEA travel index
points: Traveloka released its first SEA Index for Q2 2026, based on search and booking activity on its platform.
The report covers Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam, with Indonesia’s highest-demand domestic destination listed as Malang and international destination as Seoul.
items.context: Traveloka ranks No. 4 in the census, with US$1.02B in funding and a Travel & Mobility sector label.

items.headline: DANA backs BI’s 0% QRIS fee expansion up to Rp100,000
points: DANA said it supports Bank Indonesia’s plan to extend 0% QRIS merchant fees to transactions up to Rp100,000 across all merchant categories from Oct. 1, 2026.
The policy previously charged 0.7%, while micro-merchants stayed free up to Rp500,000; DANA said it awaits detailed rules.
items.context: DANA is rank 7 in the census, a Jakarta Selatan fintech with US$250M recorded funding and 886 estimated employees.

points: Pintu launched Pintu Futures Lite after Indonesian crypto derivatives volume reached Rp4.4T through April, Bisnis.com reported, citing CFX data quoted by the company.
The feature targets beginner and intermediate traders with leverage of up to 25 times.

items.headline: OJK puts foreign lender funding in Pindar at Rp17.28T
points: OJK said foreign lenders provided Rp17.28 trillion to Indonesia's online lending industry as of June 2026, Bisnis.com reported.
The amount rose 34.18% year on year and made up 16.43% of total industry outstanding funding.

points: Bank Indonesia launched the retail Kartu Kredit Indonesia, a domestic-network credit card for individuals and businesses, with seven initial issuers and BSI as a next mover.

items.headline: Semrush puts Tokopedia July visits at 48.7M as Blibli climbs
points: Katadata cited Semrush data showing July 2026 visits of 48.7 million for Tokopedia, 15.3 million for Blibli and 17.4 million for Lazada Indonesia.
Month on month, Tokopedia rose 2.5%, Blibli rose 41.9% and Lazada fell 5.8%.

items.headline: Paxel enters Makassar with Rp10,000 intra-city delivery tariff
points: Paxel launched service in Makassar, its first expansion on Sulawesi, after operating in Jabodetabek, Bandung, Semarang, Yogyakarta, Solo, Malang, Surabaya and Bali.
The company offers same-day intercity and interprovincial delivery and sets a Rp10,000 flat intra-city fee for parcels up to 5 kg.
items.context: Paxel is the census's No. 56 Logistics startup, with US$59M in funding and an estimated 386 employees.
